0022600025.text: The Washington Wizards (4-4, second in the Southeast and 0.5 games back, eighth in the East, coming off a loss) visit the Atlanta Hawks (5-4, first in the Southeast, fourth in the East, winners of their last two) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, the Wizards' ninth of the season. Washington trails the season series 0-1 after a 120-105 loss in Washington on November 4, and it lost 1-3 to Atlanta in the 2025-26 season. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), with Asa Newell listed as day-to-day with a toe injury and a game-time decision.
